using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
enum class AcceptanceOutcome {Accepted, DefinitelyNotAccepted, Unknown, KeyConflict, Forbidden, Invalid, Unavailable}
inline constexpr std::string_view wire_name(AcceptanceOutcome value)
inline std::optional<AcceptanceOutcome> parse_acceptance_outcome(std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(AcceptanceOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(AcceptanceOutcome value, std::string_view name)
inline constexpr bool operator==(std::string_view name, AcceptanceOutcome value)
inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, AcceptanceOutcome value)
inline const std::vector<std::string> kAcceptanceOutcomeNames

struct RequestIdentity
  std::string key
  std::string history_epoch
  std::int64_t attempt
struct Submission
  RequestIdentity identity
  std::string kind
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> spec
  std::vector<std::string> required_guarantees
  std::string label
struct Receipt
  RequestIdentity identity
  std::string logical_owner
  std::string operation_id
  std::vector<std::string> accepted_guarantees
  std::int64_t history_retention_ms
struct AcceptanceResult
  AcceptanceOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Receipt> receipt
  std::string reason
struct HistoryWindow
  std::string logical_owner
  std::string history_epoch
  std::int64_t minimum_retention_ms
  std::int64_t result_retention_ms
struct CancellationResult
  CancellationOutcome outcome
struct WorkProgress
  std::int64_t done
  std::int64_t total
struct WorkFailure
  FailureClass classification
  std::string message
  std::string cause
struct OperationSnapshot
  Receipt receipt
  WorkState state
  WorkProgress progress
  bool cancellation_requested
  std::optional<WorkFailure> failure
  std::string label
  bool label_derived
  std::string waiting
struct ObservationResult
  ObservationOutcome outcome
  std::optional<OperationSnapshot> snapshot
struct ResultChunk
  Receipt receipt
  std::int64_t offset
  std::int64_t total
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> data
  bool eof
struct ResultRead
  ResultOutcome outcome
  std::optional<ResultChunk> chunk
struct InventoryPage
  InventoryOutcome outcome
  std::vector<OperationSnapshot> snapshots
  std::string next
  bool complete
struct OperatorCancellation
  OperatorCancellationOutcome outcome
inline std::string encode(const AcceptanceResult& v)
inline AcceptanceResult decode(std::string_view data)
struct FrameWriter
  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct DispatchError : std::runtime_error
inline std::string service_name(std::string_view frame)
struct FrameExchanger
  virtual std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct ServiceError : std::runtime_error
  std::string code, message
inline constexpr std::string_view kEndpointContract
struct DescribedService
  std::string contract
  bool ready
  std::string why
std::string describe_endpoint(std::string_view frame, const std::string& program, const std::string& version, const Services& . . . services)
struct RecoverableAcceptance
  virtual HistoryWindow get_history_window()
  virtual AcceptanceResult submit(const Submission& submission)
  virtual AcceptanceResult reconcile(const RequestIdentity& identity)
  virtual CancellationResult cancel_work(const RequestIdentity& identity)
template<class Transport>struct RecoverableAcceptanceClient : RecoverableAcceptance
  Transport& transport_
  HistoryWindow get_history_window() override
  AcceptanceResult submit(const Submission& submission) override
  AcceptanceResult reconcile(const RequestIdentity& identity) override
  CancellationResult cancel_work(const RequestIdentity& identity) override
struct RecoverableAcceptanceService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct RecoverableAcceptanceDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  RecoverableAcceptance& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct OperationControl
  virtual ObservationResult observe_work(const RequestIdentity& identity)
  virtual ResultRead read_result(const RequestIdentity& identity, const std::int64_t& offset, const std::int64_t& max_bytes)
template<class Transport>struct OperationControlClient : OperationControl
  Transport& transport_
  ObservationResult observe_work(const RequestIdentity& identity) override
  ResultRead read_result(const RequestIdentity& identity, const std::int64_t& offset, const std::int64_t& max_bytes) override
struct OperationControlService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct OperationControlDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  OperationControl& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct JobInventory
  virtual InventoryPage list_work(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
template<class Transport>struct JobInventoryClient : JobInventory
  Transport& transport_
  InventoryPage list_work(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
struct JobInventoryService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct JobInventoryDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  JobInventory& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct JobOperator
  virtual InventoryPage list_account_work(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual OperatorCancellation cancel_operation(const std::string& operation_id)
template<class Transport>struct JobOperatorClient : JobOperator
  Transport& transport_
  InventoryPage list_account_work(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  OperatorCancellation cancel_operation(const std::string& operation_id) override
struct JobOperatorService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct JobOperatorDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  JobOperator& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
